entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE

entities.description: 5GSM sublayer state where PDU session release is pending.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: 5GSM sublayer state where PDU session establishment is pending.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ACTIVE
entities.description: 5GSM sublayer state where PDU session is active.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING
entities.description: 5GSM sublayer state where PDU session modification is pending.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RESUME REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to resume a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to release a PDU session.

entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject a PDU session modification command.

entities.name: PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject a PDU session release command.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDU session authentication.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDU session modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to command PDU session modification.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete PDU session modification.
